children: Evommune announced a late-breaking oral presentation of positive Phase 2a data for EVO301 in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis at EADV 2026.
Phase 2a EVO301 data will be presented in a late-breaking oral session at EADV 2026 in Vienna on Oct 1.
Presentation titled "Positive Top-line Data from the Phase 2a Proof-of-Concept Trial of EVO301" by Dr. Mark G. Lebwohl.
EVO301 is a long-acting IL-18 binding protein designed to neutralize upregulated IL-18 and address multiple inflammatory pathways.
Company expects a Phase 2b dose-ranging study in moderate-to-severe AD to begin in mid-2027, advancing its inflammation-focused pipeline.
